scale50k.method: tools/probe-scale.mjs starts set_vault and polls only get_index_status; after completion it issues one list_notes and five search_notes calls, then inspects the virtualized tree and restores the sample vault

scale50k.switchNote: contentless FTS; four runs after the schema migration, 13.1-15.5s. The older contentful number was 18.0-40.5s.
decisions: contentless + detail=none adopted: FTS drops from ~410MB content + 33MB postings to ~34MB; total index 259MiB
keep the full list payload for now: the tree needs all metadata; 0.92-0.94s after a background switch is accepted; lazy folder loading/compact IPC is the next step if 100k is required
schema migration is a one-time background rebuild: an index without index_meta.fts_schema is rebuilt through staging; the old index stays readable until the swap
staging writes emit a writing status every 500 notes so the UI no longer sits at 50,000/50,000 for the final ~7s
scale50k.limits: identical-body corpus, so FTS dictionary/compression differs from a diverse real vault; 100k not measured; contentless cannot answer phrase queries (current search only uses token AND/OR); the one-time 50k migration cost was not isolated (only the 4-note migration was timed); 50k acceptance used synthetic CDP events
